description: Assembly source code implementing AES encryption/decryption and related cryptographic functions optimized for Apple ARM64 architecture, generated from BoringSSL's Perl script.

methods.name: _aes_hw_set_encrypt_key
methods.description: Sets the encryption key for AES hardware acceleration, generating round keys based on input key and key size.

methods.name: _aes_hw_set_decrypt_key
methods.description: Sets the decryption key for AES hardware acceleration, deriving round keys from the encryption key.

methods.name: _aes_hw_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on input data using precomputed round keys.

methods.name: _aes_hw_decrypt
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on input data using precomputed round keys.

methods.name: _aes_hw_cbc_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES CBC mode encryption or decryption, handling multiple block sizes and key schedules.

methods.name: _aes_hw_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
methods.description: Performs AES CTR mode encryption on multiple blocks, optimized for ARM64 architecture.
